response.overview: *Shinas... The City of History and the Sea*  Shinas is not just a wilayat in North Al Batinah. It is a story that spans centuries.  It is one of Oman’s oldest coastal cities, and for a long time it was a vital port that connected Oman to the Arabian Gulf, Persia, and India.  Its towering forts and watchtowers tell stories of protection and resilience. Its shores bear witness to the glory of traditional dhow shipbuilding and pearl diving.  The vast palm farms, the scent of the sea, and its kind people who inherited the fishing profession from their fathers and grandfathers... all of this gives Shinas its unique character.  Shinas is the living memory of traders and sailors.  It is authenticity that never dies, and a sea that never forgets its people.  A city with ancient roots, and a modern spirit carried by its people.
